question: Across the exact 69+21 composed 90-case source, what is V9's randomized-block performance relative to original M-TARE, and which causal graph mechanisms explain its failures?
method: Verify both immutable source seals, the exact 69+21 source map, 90 schedule identities and generator hashes. Map only V2 status in deep memory copies into the frozen seven-metric ten-block analyzer; validate every V9 row and traversal, quantify both graph defects, then nominate one live-probe case without performance outcomes.
baseline: Mechanism audit only; original M-TARE remains the primary performance baseline in the unchanged randomized-block statistics.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable read-only composed-source Gate-6 audit after V3R seals.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope.

acceptance_criteria: The predecessor FAILED seal and V3R COMPLETED seal are exact; the source map contains exactly 69 predecessor and 21 recovery cases.
All 90 scheduled V2-PASS summaries form ten complete nine-case blocks and 30/30/30 method quotas; tunnel_env23 is entirely from V3R and case077 partial is absent.
All four source-generator files match their direct frozen hashes, including the causal graph and frontier planner omitted as direct V3R spec entries.
All 30 V9 trace/snapshot pairs pass exact row, target, graph path, traversal endpoint and traversal-event bijection contracts.

The unchanged preregistered analyzer receives all 90 cases through the status-only in-memory bridge and emits seven metric comparisons, block records, exact sign-flip tests, bootstrap intervals and Holm corrections.
All classified event totals recompute exactly; probe nomination uses no coverage/travel/latency outcome; raw bag, GT/map, training, checkpoint/parameter selection, C09 and C10 reads are zero.
stop_conditions: Any source state, seal, map, schedule, case, generator or direct-hash drift.
Any selective predecessor tunnel_env23 reuse or failed case077 partial read.
Any malformed target, row, path, traversal, event, aggregate or provenance.
Any source mutation, bag/GT/map read, training, checkpoint/parameter/performance-outcome selection or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: Verified two-source provenance and exact 90-case composition manifest.
Four direct generator identities and 60 sealed trace/snapshot identities.
Frozen randomized-block performance analysis plus thirty V1R3 causal audits, per-case re-anchor evidence, outcome-blind probe nomination, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; no simulation, ROS, GPU or bags.
